bias.en: Bearish · SAR flipped bullish, capped under $296
bias.zh: 看空 · SAR 翻多，受制于 $296 下方

read.en: Alphabet rose 1.2% on Nov 9 to $288.15, trading $288.09–296.33 and closing at the low. It is above the falling 5-day average ($284.9) but below the falling 10-day ($291.3), 30-day ($324.9), 100-day ($340.8) and 200-day ($339.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 and below zero, histogram narrowing for three sessions; Parabolic SAR turned bullish on Nov 9 ($276.92), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: Alphabet 11月9日上涨 1.2%，收于 $288.15，盘中区间 $288.09–296.33，收于最低点附近。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$284.9）上方，但仍低于下行的 10 日（$291.3）、30 日（$324.9）、100 日（$340.8）和 200 日均线（$339.3）。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图连续三个交易日收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月9日翻为看多（$276.92），RSI 为 33。

read.en: No level changed: the $296.33 high reached the $294.1–296.5 band, but the close slipped back under $290.5 and the 10-day. Resistance is $290.5–291.3 (Nov 6 high, 10-day), then $294.1–296.5 (Mar 9 low, Nov 4, 5 and 9 highs) and $300. Support is $283.4–284.9 (5-day, Nov 4 low, Oct 29 close), then $276.9–277.2 (SAR) and $270.7–272.1. A close above $296.5 would target $300; below $283.4, $277.

r.en: Mar 9 low $294.1; Nov 5 high $295.6; Nov 9 high $296.33; Nov 4 high $296.5

s.en: Parabolic SAR and Oct 30 low $276.92; Nov 5 low $277.07; Nov 3 low $277.2
